You thrust a bright palm between your companion and the threat. For an instant, every shadow on their face falls behind them.

Rules

Action

One visible willing ally within 3 squares before a defense roll.
Type

Reduce the target's temporary Blinded and Frightened by 1 each before the defense. It gains 2 Boons to that defense.
